Name: Lazarus
Summary: Lazarus was Jesus' beloved friend in Bethany whose death after four days became the stage for one of Jesus' greatest signs. At Jesus' word — Lazarus, come out — he walked from the tomb alive.
KeyStory: Jesus wept at Lazarus's tomb, prayed aloud, and cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come out, and the dead man emerged bound in grave clothes.
LifeLesson: Jesus wept even knowing resurrection was minutes away — He enters our grief before He overturns it. If He called Lazarus out of four days dead, no situation of yours is beyond His voice.
